name: univer
description: The Office Harness for AI Agents — Spreadsheets, Docs, Slides, Canvas, Relational Tables, and PDF in one runtime.
one_liner: A toolkit developers use to build their own spreadsheet, document, and presentation editor right inside their own app or website — like embedding a mini Excel or Google Docs, including letting AI agents read and edit the files.
buyer: A B2B SaaS company (e.g. a BI dashboard, CRM, or internal-tools platform) that needs spreadsheet or document editing built into their product without building an editor from scratch.
business_use_cases: An internal-tools platform embeds live spreadsheet editing directly into its dashboards so customers can tweak numbers without exporting to Excel.
A BI startup lets AI agents write formulas and charts directly into customer-facing spreadsheet reports, cutting analyst hours.
A vertical SaaS (e.g. for accountants) builds a branded, in-app document/spreadsheet editor instead of licensing an expensive third-party office suite.

money_ideas.idea: Build a vertical SaaS product on top (like Univer Workspace) and charge per seat for teams and their AI agents to collaborate on documents.
Offer paid integration/customization services to companies embedding the open-core SDK into their own products.

steal_this: This weekend, embed Univer's spreadsheet component into a simple internal dashboard for a small business client (e.g. inventory or budget tracking) and charge for the custom build.
